## Pull request title

Start the pull request title with a category prefix and a short description, using the format `[prefix]: <short description>`. Use the same prefixes as commit subjects:

| Prefix | Use for |
| --- | --- |
| `[fix]` | Bugfixes |
| `[feat]` | Features |
| `[build]` | Build changes |
| `[chore]` | Chores |
| `[ci]` | Continuous integration changes |
| `[docs]` | Documentation |
| `[style]` | Style changes |
| `[ref]` | Refactoring |
| `[perf]` | Performance improvements |
| `[test]` | Tests |

Example: `[feat]: export results as CSV`.

## Summary

<!-- What changed and why? -->

## Validation

<!-- How did you verify this change? -->
